What we do not collect

Hushwalls has no accounts and no server of ours that stores user data. We do not collect your name, email address, precise location, contacts, the photos in your gallery, microphone or camera.

Ads and your consent

Hushwalls is free with ads: a banner on the browse pages, an occasional full-screen ad when you leave a preview, and an optional ad you can watch before saving a wallpaper to your gallery. Where Google's rules require it (for example in the EEA, the UK and some US states), a consent form from Google is shown when the app starts, and ads are requested only after that step allows them. You can change your choice later in Settings under Ad privacy options, where that option is shown. Ad content is limited to the general-audience rating. On Android you can also reset your advertising ID or opt out of ads personalization in Android Settings.

The Remove ads purchase

Remove ads is a one-time purchase made through Google Play. RevenueCat helps us confirm it and restore it (Settings, Restore purchase, with the same Google account). We never receive your payment details. Owners of Remove ads see no banner, no full-screen ads and no ad step before saving.

Crash reports

The current version does not send crash reports or usage analytics. If a later version adds crash reporting, we will update this policy before it ships.

Permissions

Set wallpaper: to apply a wallpaper you choose. Internet and network state: to load the wallpaper list and images. Advertising ID: used by Google AdMob for ads, subject to your consent choices. Billing: for the Remove ads purchase. Storage is requested only on Android 9 and older, and only when you tap save; newer Android versions need no storage permission.

AI-generated art

The wallpapers are created with AI image tools and chosen by us; wallpapers made with AI carry an "ai-art" mark in the app. No real people are depicted.

Service providers

The app uses these third-party services, which process data on our behalf under their own privacy terms:

  • RevenueCat — subscription and purchase status (privacy policy)
  • Google AdMob — advertising (privacy policy)

Children

Hushwalls is meant for people aged 16 and over and is not directed to children. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 16. If you believe a child has used the app, email us and we will help.

Your rights

Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR or the CCPA) you may have the right to access, correct, delete or export your data and to object to certain processing. Contact mercurysols197@gmail.com (or use the support page) and we will respond within 30 days.

Security and transfers

Data is transmitted over encrypted connections. Service providers may process data in countries other than yours.

Changes

If this policy changes materially we will update the date above and, where required, tell you in the app.
